name: Columbia Road Flower Market
summary: A Sunday street market on Columbia Road, where traders sell flowers, houseplants, herbs, bulbs and shrubs along a narrow Victorian street with more than 60 independent businesses.
crowd: Time Out says tourists and locals both turn up in big numbers, and it gets jostly around midday.

evidence.quote: It takes place each Sunday, when market traders line the narrow Victorian street selling flowers, houseplants, herbs, bulbs and shrubs.
the quaint little street is home to over 60 independent businesses
it draws large crowds of tourists and locals alike
During the midday rush you may well find yourself being jostled
Columbia Road Flower Market is a street market in Bethnal Green in London, England.
